newsitem.title: USA: May to open 13 stores in 1997.
newsitem.headline: May to open 13 stores in 1997.

text.p: May Department Stores Co said Tuesday it plans to open 13 new stores in 1997, adding two million square feet of retail space.
In 1996, it opened 28 department stores, 13 of which were acquired, bringing it to a total of 365 stores at the end of fiscal 1996.

"We acquired 13 Strawbridge's stores in 1996, strengthening our position in Philadelphia," David Farrell, chairman, said in a statement. "We now have 21 Strawbridge's stores in the greater Philadelphia area, which are operated by Hecht's, our largest department store division."

Earlier, May reported earnings for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1996, ended February 1, of $1.59 a share on a fully diluted basis, up from $1.36 a year ago. For fiscal 1996, it earned $2.84 a share, up from $2.81 a year ago.
"May achieved a 19.4 percent return on equity" in fiscal 1996, Farrell said. "The return continues to place us in the top quartile of the retail industry."
He added that May is confident it will continue to achieve results that place it in the top quartile.
